recipebookplus.configuration.title: RecipeBook+ Configuration
recipebookplus.configuration.general.too: General client-side visuals. Configure how mod looks and toggle optional features
recipebookplus.configuration.mod_enabled:
Determines if mod is enabled
If "OFF" reverts the recipe book to vanilla behavior
recipebookplus.configuration.ingredient_:
Determines prefix for search string to let recipe book know you are looking for recipies that use that item
Default: "$"
recipebookplus.configuration.modid_prefi:
Determines prefix for search string to let recipe book know you are looking for recipies that are added by certain mod
Default: "@"
recipebookplus.configuration.use_custom_: Determines which recipe book UI to use. If "ON" then new custom ui is used. Otherwise modified vanilla one will be rendered
recipebookplus.configuration.hudoverlay_:
Determines anchor of the hud overlay element on screen. If "NONE" game will skip rendering the overlay
§6Also hides vanilla new recipes toast§r
Determines horizontal offset in pixels from screen edge. can be negative
